topic: make a scanned document's text searchable and selectable
core_question: How do I turn a scanned image of a document into text I can search or copy?
answer_summary: Use OCR software (e.g., Adobe Acrobat's 'Recognize Text' or a scanning app's OCR option) to convert the scanned image into searchable, selectable text.
